parsed.name: 实验室仪器枚举器
parsed.description: 这不是单一物理仪器，而是一个用于实验室自动化的仪器发现与识别工具。它用于扫描通过 VISA、GPIB、串口等接口连接的测试测量设备，读取设备标识信息，并将已发现的仪器与可用驱动进行匹配，便于后续接入和控制。
parsed.description_en: This is not a single physical instrument but a laboratory automation utility for instrument discovery and identification. It scans test and measurement devices connected through interfaces such as VISA, GPIB, and serial links, reads identification strings, and matches discovered instruments to available drivers for later control.
